{
  "milestones": [
    {
      "id": "m1",
      "title": "Add condition parameter to cached/cachedmethod decorators",
      "requests": [
        "R2"
      ],
      "requirement": "The @cached and @cachedmethod decorators must accept an optional 'condition' argument (a threading.Condition instance) that, when provided, uses the condition's lock to serialize cache misses and prevent stampede.",
      "observable": "@cached(cache={}, condition=threading.Condition()) wraps a function such that concurrent calls with the same key result in only one computation; wrapper.cache_info() returns hits/misses correctly.",
      "public_names": [
        "cached",
        "cachedmethod"
      ],
      "requires": [],
      "why_requires": "This adds the core mechanism (the condition-based locking logic in the decorator wrappers) that subsequent milestones will rely on or modify."
    },
    {
      "id": "m2",
      "title": "Integrate condition into func decorators via cached",
      "requests": [
        "R3"
      ],
      "requirement": "The cachetools.func decorators (lru_cache, ttl_cache, etc.) should internally use a threading.Condition to handle cache stampede, leveraging the infrastructure added in m1.",
      "observable": "@lru_cache() decorated function handles concurrent identical calls by computing only once; the underlying cache is protected by a condition lock.",
      "public_names": [
        "lru_cache",
        "ttl_cache",
        "fifo_cache",
        "lfu_cache",
        "rr_cache"
      ],
      "requires": [
        "m1"
      ],
      "why_requires": "The func decorators need to instantiate and pass a Condition to the cached decorator (or replicate its logic if refactored), which depends on the behavior defined in m1. Specifically, they must create a Condition and pass it to the caching wrapper."
    },
    {
      "id": "m3",
      "title": "Deprecate None return in cachedmethod",
      "requests": [
        "R4"
      ],
      "requirement": "When @cachedmethod's key function returns None for a given call, a DeprecationWarning should be raised instead of silently suppressing caching.",
      "observable": "Calling a method decorated with @cachedmethod where the key function returns None raises a DeprecationWarning.",
      "public_names": [
        "cachedmethod"
      ],
      "requires": [
        "m1"
      ],
      "why_requires": "This modifies the behavior of cachedmethod, which was established in m1. The warning logic needs to be inserted into the wrapper generated by cachedmethod."
    }
  ],
  "expected_causes": [
    "Developers might fail to properly integrate the Condition object into the existing _cached_locked_info/_cached_unlocked_info flow, leading to race conditions or deadlocks.",
    "In m2, developers might incorrectly assume that lru_cache already has stampede protection or might struggle to inject the Condition creation into the _cache helper without breaking existing signatures.",
    "For m3, developers might miss checking for None in the specific code path of cachedmethod's key resolution before the cache lookup."
  ],
  "verifier_plan": "Tests will import cachetools.cached and cachetools.cachedmethod. For m1, a test will create a Condition, decorate a function, and verify that concurrent calls trigger only one execution. For m2, tests will check that standard func decorators like lru_cache behave correctly under concurrency using the new internal condition. For m3, a test will define a class with a cachedmethod where the key function returns None and assert that a DeprecationWarning is issued."
}
